title: Red Alert: Heavy Rainfall & Landslide Warning at Pykara Ghat Road
summary: Nilgiris District Administration has temporarily closed Pykara Ghat stretch due to mudslides and heavy continuous rainfall. Use alternate diversion route via Gudalur Main bypass.
recommendedActions: Avoid traveling to waterfall slopes after 04:00 PM
Adhere to police barricades and checkpoints
Keep vehicle headlights on in dense mist

title: Restricted Access in Dry Deciduous Buffer of Mudumalai
summary: Trekking prohibited in peripheral forest sectors due to seasonal dry brush and animal movement corridors.
recommendedActions: No unauthorized walking trails off safari tracks
Smoking and open campfires are strictly penalized
